Class InputTypeMousePositionDelta

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Input
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Represents an input type that tracks the delta of the mouse position relative to a target position. Supports deadzone threshold and optional modifier keys.

public sealed class InputTypeMousePositionDelta : IInputType, IEquatable<IInputType>, ICopyable<IInputType>
